question_text: Hillsdale Bedding needs to ship 61 pillows across the country. Each shipping container can hold 29 pillows. How many pillows will be in the partially full container?
solution: The number of pillows in the partially full container = Remainder of pillows left after dividing the number of pillows by the number each shipping container holds.
$61 = 29 \times 2 + 3$. The remainder is 3 so, there will be 3 pillows in the partially full container.
